description: $0.05 USDC on Solana per grade - the payment buys one deterministic grade of the one probe transcript you submit: five probes (persistence truth; scope coherence; replay duplication; repeatable read; feature liveness) each graded RUNNABLE / PARTIAL / NOT RUNNABLE against the declared family's published expectation table with the table entry cited per probe, a behavioural outcome per probe, the family's binding-strength wording, the canary status, and the factors. Factors printed; no composite score. The grade grades the submitted transcript of a challenge run only - it is not a certification of your production store.

canary_echo.description: The nonce exactly as it came back through the store's read paths (the canary echo).

claimed_expectations.description: Optional claimed expectations: probe ids mapped to RUNNABLE / PARTIAL / NOT RUNNABLE.

declared_scope.description: Optional declared scope of the run ("synthetic" for a script run).

family.description: The memory-store family the probe run targeted: mem0, zep-cloud, graphiti, or letta.

issued_nonce.description: The per-run nonce the published script issued for this run (8-256 characters).

probes.description: Entries for the five probes (persistence_truth, scope_coherence, replay_duplication, repeatable_read, feature_liveness), each with status observed-pass / observed-fail / not-run and an evidence object.

script_id.description: The published probe script id the run followed (probe-script/<family>/v1).

name: probe_grade_grade
